channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Darvin Ham | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Darvin Ham from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Myles Turner on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Myles Turner:

“Darvin Ham has such a great quote after practice the other day, you know, I live downtown and you know, I respect the people, you know, who are out there working construction, it is so loud, you know what I mean? But, you know,those guys are literally out there busting concrete for damn near minimum wage, and we are expected to come out here, keep ourselves in shape, and, you know, play basketball to make the checks that we make. So, I try to keep that perspective no matter where I am at.”

Myles Turner on Darvin Ham, Oct 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Giannis:

“That's what they told you? I thought Coach had to use the restroom. [laughs] That’s what they said—Coach had to use the restroom. That’s why we did that on the bench. I’m joking. But yeah, I’ve been with Coach for four or five years. I know his playbook, how he operates. It’s home for me. Maybe different for other guys, but we’ve got a great coaching staff. If Coach Doc or Darvin goes down, the next guy can step up—Coach Dave, Coach Pry, even Coach V. And congrats to Coach Doc—he just passed Phil Jackson in all-time wins. We’ve got to do a video tribute when we get back home. Hope he feels better—we’ll need him.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Darvin Ham, Apr 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Darvin Ham, Frank Vogel
item.description:
“Remember, I got your Lakers games, you can’t hide them flaws they got. You just a dead man walking — they got rid of Frank Vogel who did a good job, they got rid of Darvin Ham who did a good job. You came out there thinking you were gonna change things with that same ugly girl you went on a date with – the Lakers stink.,”

Charles Barkley on Darvin Ham, Frank Vogel, Jan 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“It’s been great. First of all, he’s been here even longer than me. He knows things that I didn’t know. He has relationships with the players. Another guy that can trust. Trust is so important for players. And more importantly, he deserves it. I’m not going to get into the whole thing that happened there, but he took a team to a Western Finals, and then the following year, he won the in-season tournament, which they say we should have a lot of value on, and then they release him. It literally makes no sense, but it happens. It happens to all of us. It’s part of what we do. But Darvin Ham’s a coach, he should be on the sidelines, and I wanted him next to me.”

Doc Rivers on Darvin Ham, Oct 10, 2024. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James, Darvin Ham, Bronny James
item.description:
After he got unfollowed, Perkins addressed the issue on First Take and again blasted James.

“Imagine unfollowing me on Twitter, but you still got to wake up and watch me on TV every day. Because. I ain't going nowhere anytime soon – that's number one. Number two, I think LeBron James got sensitive over the last couple of weeks because I’ve been calling him out or have been speaking on things that he might disagree with. Like the firing of Darvin Ham or the coaching search of the Lakers or even having to touch on the Bronny James situation when it comes down to dealing with the draft,”

Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James, Darvin Ham, Bronny James, Jun 11, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Michael Malone on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Michael Malone:

“I think Darvin Ham is a hell of a coach. That’s not an easy job. I think Darvin does it with class. He’s a good man, good coach, and I wish him all the best. Hopefully, he’ll be around there for a long time because he deserves to be.”

Michael Malone on Darvin Ham, Apr 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Darvin Ham
item.description:
“His relationship with Darvin is the reason I couldn't have a relationship with Darvin,”

D'Angelo Russell on Darvin Ham, Mar 14, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Jovan Buha:LeBron James on how Darvin Ham has managed the team's recent ups and downs:

“By just staying and trying to keep us prepared when it's time to go out and for battle.”

LeBron James on Darvin Ham, Jan 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Michael Malone on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Los Angeles Lakers

“If they are still worried about us, that’s on them. I have tremendous respect for the Lakers, I have tremendous respect for Darvin Ham. But if they are still worried about us, that’s on them”

Michael Malone on Darvin Ham, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @Tjonesonthenba.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, Jeanie Buss, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“Jeanie [Buss] and Darvin [Ham] and I were just probably the most excited to just get Anthony's perspective on what it means to do an extension like this and what it means to become a leader of the Lakers for years to come,”

Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, Jeanie Buss, Anthony Davis, Aug 9, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham
item.description:
“So, I don’t want to put a limit on what either of these guys can do either for coach Ham and the team. They’re going to start with the foundation of work. If they earn minutes in our rotation, that’s because they put in the work to do it. I do think guys can be impactful in this league, even young players.”

Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, Jun 28, 2023. Source: The Sporting Tribune.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Rob Pelinka:

“This was a season of advancement and growth ... It starts by giving credit to Darvin [Ham] and his staff... This was a team that competed to the bitter end and that's something as an organization that we owe to our fans”

Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, May 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: James Worthy on LeBron James, Darvin Ham
item.description:
Worthy said on Spectrum SportsNet.

“It’s very difficult, they load up on LeBron. We know [Russ], his attitude is to attack, but sometimes the defense collapses and they end up with a turnover or not even a shot at all.“That’s something I’m sure coach Ham got to address because it’s happened several times – couple times in overtime, other game where they’re right there for the win – can’t execute down the stretch.”

James Worthy on LeBron James, Darvin Ham, Jan 19, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Mike Budenholzer on his longtime former assistant:

“(Darvin’s) a leader. Even as an assistant here, a great leader. He has an unbelievable combination of toughness and grit. Nobody wants to be on the wrong side of Darvin. At the same time he’s incredibly caring and thoughtful.”

Mike Budenholzer on Darvin Ham, Dec 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Matt Ryan on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Brad Turner:Austin Reaves his pass to Matt Ryan:

“Yeah, when Darvin drew it up, I was like, ‘There’s no way I’m throwing it.’ I’ve seen this play a million times and I’ve seen it work maybe once... Andthe AD set a really good screen so I was like, ‘I got to throw it.’”

Matt Ryan on Darvin Ham, Nov 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @BA_Turner.

item.title: Charles Lee on Darvin Ham
item.description:
“And the fact that I compete with these players, with this coaching staff, it’s been an exciting summer. I’m really happy for Darvin but I’m also looking forward to the opportunity to continue to grow as a coach.”

Charles Lee on Darvin Ham, Aug 30, 2022. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham
item.description:
“When someone begins his NBA coaching career at the G League level and goes all the way through playing an integral role on the front bench of an NBA Championship team, it really speaks to a certain strength of character. Our players and fans will immediately identify with Darvin’s no-nonsense and hard-working approach, which we feel will bring toughness and a competitive edge to all we do,”

Rob Pelinka on Darvin Ham, Jun 3, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Al Horford on Darvin Ham
item.description:
John Karalis:Al Horford on his former assistant coach Darvin Ham getting the Lakers job:

“Darvin is about as good a guy as you're going to see, a big competitor. Extreme competitor. The Lakers are really lucky to have a guy like him. He's the kind of guy that you want.”

Al Horford on Darvin Ham, Jun 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Darvin Ham
item.description:
However, Hall of Famer Charles Barkley seems to think the hire isn’t going to move the needle for L.A. He recently explained his thinking.

“Well I’m glad Darvin got an opportunity ’cause he’s paid his dues,”

Charles Barkley on Darvin Ham, Jun 1, 2022. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Ham spent the last two seasons as an assistant coach with the Los Angeles Lakers.

“Darvin has a great feel for the game and knows what it takes for a team to be successful and compete at a high level,”

Mike Budenholzer on Darvin Ham, Jun 15, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Brown said in a statement released by the team.

“I've known Darvin since his rookie year in Denver and have watched him make the transition from player to coach. He has put in the hard work that is necessary to have success at this level and I look forward to having him on our staff.”

Mike Brown on Darvin Ham, Oct 25, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
